evidence_boundary: New model condition, NOT comparable with the Qwen2.5-Coder-3B series or the gemma-3-4b run: different model family and size (Gemma 4 12B QAT), different quantization (Q4_0), LM Studio OpenAI-compatible backend. Same tasks, prompt variants, run order, and scorer as the earlier dependency-mirror experiments. Decoding difference versus the protocol default: reasoning_effort=none, because this hybrid-reasoning model otherwise spends the entire 256-token budget on reasoning_content and returns empty content (observed in an aborted first attempt on 2026-10-11: 253/256 reasoning tokens, 0 content chars, run discarded before completion). Purpose: model-ladder step ~12B — test whether the dependency-mirror tasks rise above the patch-serialization floor with a stronger local instruct model, and whether any variant difference appears.
